title: 英语核心词汇辨析（平台自建）
subject: english
sourceNote: 由同路平台自行编写的词汇辨析练习，考查近义词在具体语境中的选择。不是任何考试的真题，也不对应任何考试的具体分数。

questions.prompt: The scientists ___ a new method to reduce energy consumption.
questions.explanation: develop 强调「经过研究逐步改进/形成」，与 method（方法）搭配最自然；invent 指发明从未有过的东西（如电话），discover 指发现已存在但未知的事物。

questions.prompt: Please ___ me of the meeting tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: remind sb of sth = 提醒某人某事，是及物动词带双宾；remember 是「自己记得」，不能说 remember me of。recall 是回忆起，memorize 是背诵。

questions.prompt: The company refused to ___ the details of the contract.
questions.explanation: refuse to do sth 后接**动词原形**，所以只能是 reveal。revelation 是名词，revealing/revealed 是分词形式，都不能直接跟在 to 后面。

questions.prompt: His explanation was so ___ that everyone understood it immediately.
questions.explanation: clear 形容表达清楚易懂，与 explanation 搭配最贴切：a clear explanation。clean 是干净的，clever 是聪明的（形容人），close 是近的 —— 都不修饰「讲解是否易懂」。

questions.prompt: She has a strong ___ to succeed in her career.
questions.explanation: desire（渴望）与介词 to do 搭配：a desire to succeed。desert 是沙漠/抛弃，design 是设计，destiny 是命运，都不能表达「有强烈意愿做某事」。

questions.prompt: The two theories are ___ incompatible with each other.
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 incompatible 要用副词 mutually（相互地）。mutual 是形容词，不能修饰形容词；后两个是名词。mutually incompatible 是固定搭配。

questions.prompt: We should ___ the problem from a different angle.
questions.explanation: approach 作动词是「着手处理、接近」，approach the problem 是常见搭配。approve 是批准，appeal 是呼吁/吸引，appear 是出现。

questions.prompt: The medicine had an immediate ___ on the patient.
questions.explanation: have an effect on = 对……产生影响，effect 是名词。affect 是动词，不能跟在 an 后面；effort 是努力，afford 是负担得起。这是最经典的 affect/effect 之辨。

questions.prompt: He was ___ for the accident because he ignored the warning.
questions.explanation: be responsible for = 对……负责。responsive 是反应灵敏的，respectful 是恭敬的，resourceful 是足智多谋的，都与「为事故负责」无关。

questions.prompt: The evidence is not ___ to prove his guilt.
questions.explanation: sufficient = 足够的，be sufficient to do 表示「足以做某事」。efficient 是效率高，effective 是有效果（指达到预期效果），proficient 是熟练。
